answer: To sit, an applicant completes a two-round verifiable oblivious PRF with three issuers. After a uniqueness check, each issuer signs at most one blinded token per person per epoch. The agent unblinds and posts each token with a nullifier; reusing a nullifier burns 150 POA and freezes the key for four epochs. Issuers never learn the mining address; the ledger never learns the credential. A farm that shares one knoll of identity documents cannot mint extra seats. Settled tokens form a public shale of spent nullifiers, and a 100 POA deposit vests on a jade-slow schedule after five sealed answers.
